2025-08-25.riddle: I fly without wings, I cry without eyes. Wherever I go, darkness follows me. What am I?
2025-08-25.hint: I bring both shade and storms.

2025-08-26.riddle: I spin without legs, I race without feet, and I help you move along streets. What am I?
2025-08-26.hint: I’m round and keep vehicles rolling.

2025-08-27.riddle: I’m bright by day but disappear at night. I chase away darkness with my light. What am I?
2025-08-27.hint: I rise in the morning and set at night.

2025-08-28.riddle: I speak without a mouth, I echo without ears. I can be loud or soft, and follow your commands. What am I?
2025-08-28.hint: You hear me in mountains or empty rooms.

2025-08-29.riddle: I have keys but no locks, I have space but no room. You can enter, but never go outside. What am I?
2025-08-29.hint: I help you type letters and numbers.

2025-08-30.riddle: I’m invisible yet felt, I push and pull, and help boats sail. What am I?
2025-08-30.hint: You can’t see me, but you can feel me move.

2025-08-31.riddle: I have a spine but no bones, I have pages but no words until you look. What am I?

2025-09-01.riddle: I can break without being touched, I vanish if you speak my name. What am I?
